message_forms.detail: Investigation complete. The loop is a sight-boundary controller cancellation: hunt/seek-loot moves from (28,170) into (29,169), visibility expands from 0-3 to 6-9 mice, the nearby-breeder swarm shortcut arms melee:choke, and its direction command successfully moves back to (28,170), where sight contracts and the choke controller relinquishes ownership. All repeated melee:choke commands in the fixed tail were moves, not attacks; the lone ordinary melee held position and logged an attack/kill. detected_monsters was empty throughout. One new mouse index proves limited multiplication, but stable index sets prove the 1/9 oscillation is line of sight. The policy breaker requires 24 private outcome-free samples while only 23 supplied fixed snapshots are reconstructable and its private deque is not recorded; _is_oscillating was advisory and starved by higher-priority combat/hunt returns; the CLI observed-stationarity guard correctly counted moving melee:* decisions and stopped at 40. This is the third choke/controller-arbitration strike; findings recommend a persistent validated choke engagement plan rather than another point exception. Full evidence and proposals are in SOL-FINDINGS-choke-dance-orccave.md.

Made melee-swarm choke combat one persistent tactical owner with reposition, validate, hold, release and breakthrough phases. The plan records its floor, observed openness-2 destination, covered retreat direction, triggering hostile identities and last-seen cells, last movement, bounded sight-loss count and release cause. Active reposition/hold ownership runs before hunt, seek-loot, explore and other routine routing, so sight contraction cannot reverse the owned edge; only movement toward the stable destination or an explicit release is allowed. Release telemetry covers kill-progress, swarm-growth, ranged-threat, HP/emergency authority, breeder breakthrough, invalid/unreachable destination, the existing combat-outcome sight-loss bound and floor change. The reviewed throw/shoot, contact-streak weapon restore and openness-2 melee/hold order remains intact; the convergence shortcut, CLI guards, emitter, quests and town logic were not changed.

message_forms.title: Recall out of multiplied breeder floors without cycling back

Quest predicate covers a TAKEN allowlisted fixed quest on its emitted quest floor plus any incomplete TAKEN KILL_LEVEL, KILL_NUMBER, or RANDOM quest whose explicit quest-floor id or dungeon/depth matches the current floor; those states retain the existing stair breakthrough and never read recall. State/exits: (1) latched ordinary/scavenge, usable recall, no quest -> identity-bound read, then existing recall wait/town transition; (2) latched exact mine -> existing fundraising walk-to-upstairs exits, with breakthrough backstop if that handler exhausts; (3) latched active quest -> existing ascend/seek-upstairs/seek-frontier behavior, no recall and no fled-floor walkout latch; (4) latched non-quest with no usable recall -> existing breakthrough route reaches and ascends upstairs, recording the fled floor; (5) recorded fled floor while observed above it in the same dungeon -> existing return owner takes visible/remembered/hidden upstairs, exploration, search, probe, or wander exits and descent stays blocked; exact mine continues with allow_recall false; (6) town or another dungeon observed -> fled-floor fact clears and ordinary entry/descent becomes reachable again; (7) stair command rejected on the source floor -> breakthrough latch and returning-to-town state retry the existing concrete escape routes; (8) no fled-floor fact -> ordinary policy unchanged. COMPANION INFERENCE BEYOND THE USER'S SENTENCE: recording the fled floor and continuing upward is required when no recall scroll exists, otherwise the measured 20F->19F->20F cycle remains; this is observation-based, has no counter/cooldown/timer, preserves a bot-takeable town exit, and clears on observed town/other-dungeon arrival. message_forms.title: Validate current loadout before dungeon departure
message_forms.detail: Corrected the premise in full: preparation and result must exist; no live equipment transaction session may exist; and _current_worn_loadout_confirmed must validate the CURRENT snapshot rather than preparation.current. That predicate rebuilds carried equipment from snapshot.inventory/equipment, derives the live current item-id set, accepts an exact result.best.loadout match, or accepts a different target only for a real planner transaction whose blockers are exclusively cursed-equipped or pack-space-required and whose blocker-specific valve proves it cannot advance this visit. For timeout/incomplete results with best=None it requires at least one worn item and rejects every legal owned pack/Home item that can immediately fill an empty fixed, hand, shield, or ring slot. Thus a light-only character with weapon/armour packed or catalogued at Home cannot satisfy the premise; a timed-out result with best=None proves nothing and is safe only through this independent live vacancy test. The five valves now have production-shaped pins: heavy/unactionable curse uses plan_equipment_transactions with non-empty cursed takeoff actions; terminal pack space uses a real five-takeoff plan whose peak exceeds capacity; timeout uses the optimizer preparation shape including best=None; suppression uses WarriorOptimizationPreparation/current catalog state; deferred incomplete catalog uses current carried/catalog state. messages.establishment: This is a new corner of the equipment-transaction/Home-errand seam, not a localized defect in one owner: at least four independently stateful owners arbitrate route, address, mutation, retention, and posting, and each can release or rearm another without one visit-scoped authority.

required_structural_fix.direction: Unify every physical Home visit under one HomeVisitExecutor, using HomeErrandExecutor as the precedent rather than adding another retention/cooldown guard.
contract: File a typed visit request before approach: scan, deposit, withdraw, equipment mutation, calibration restore, or recovery; no legacy Home owner may directly approach, select, rearm, or leave.

The executor exclusively owns approach, entry observation, fresh address evidence, one composed operation, exit confirmation, and terminal result. It exposes visible state and a bounded attempt budget that cannot be reset by replanning or optimizer-session replacement.

Retention and optimizer output are immutable request preconditions checked before filing and again against the observed pack identity; owner release cancels the request and cannot fall through to a different Home mutation in the same visit.
A physical entry/exit generation is the visit identity. Town-plan and equipment-session consumers receive the executor result but cannot pop attempted latches or rebuild the active visit.

Posting requires a context token from the latest joined observation. Outside-only commands and Home commands are withheld while entry or leave is inflight; generic periodic/rest owners cannot preempt that barrier.

Migrate consumers in per-module batches: standing digger, equipment deposit/withdraw, calibration restore, identification, generic deposit, scan/recovery; delete each legacy pending field only after its consumer is migrated and checkpoint replay pins the replacement.
